# Play — Betwixt

- SudokuPad: [Betwixt on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Betwixt on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Everything is exported as native f-puzzles constraints: sandwich sums as `sandwichsum` clues outside the grid, and between lines as
`betweenline`. The field names come from the f-puzzles parser in Rangsk's SudokuSolver. Fed this exact export (without the
solution), that solver finds the same unique solution, which is a good sign the link encodes the puzzle correctly. I have
not opened the links in a browser myself.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
